README.txt.content:
--------------------
Level 3
--------------------

You have penetrated deeper into the distributed computing framework. The cluster 
is currently processing thousands of automated system heartbeats every second.

The initialization token is mixed into a heavy live diagnostic stream inside the 
Master_Relay_Buffer. Reading through it normally is impossible due to the sheer volume 
of automated chatter.

When a log file is flooded with predictable, repetitive noise, you can perform 
an INVERSE search to strip out the garbage. The '-v' flag tells grep to print 
only the lines that DO NOT match the specified keyword:
  grep -v "GARBAGE_KEYWORD" <filename>

Commands Available:
  cd, ls, ls -a, cat, grep

Filter out the automated system noise to expose the token.
